title: FORMAT of BLANK is an empty string, not BLANK
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "named", FORMAT ( BLANK (), "Currency" ), "custom", FORMAT ( BLANK (), "#,0.00" ) )

source.quote: If value is BLANK, the function returns an empty string.
The result is always a string, even when the value is blank.
source.supports: the examples show an empty result for FORMAT ( BLANK (), "Currency" ) and FORMAT ( BLANK (), "#,0.00" )
